prototypes.label: pen010
prototypes.design: Penalty beta (x00 - x10 - x01 + x11) on every complete cell, beta = 0.1 r (5112 rows)

prototypes.label: c015
prototypes.design: Response eigenvectors below 0.15 r whose local-waffle fraction exceeds 0.5, projected out

prototypes.label: c025
prototypes.design: Response eigenvectors below 0.25 r whose local-waffle fraction exceeds 0.5, projected out

prototypes.label: pre015
prototypes.design: As c015, and the family signature also removed from the slopes before the solve

prototypes.label: pre025
prototypes.design: As c025, and the family signature also removed from the slopes before the solve

prototypes.label: pre040
prototypes.design: Cutoff 0.40 r, and the family signature also removed from the slopes before the solve

prototypes.label: dmx020
prototypes.design: Local-waffle eigenvectors (fraction > 0.5) of the band below 2 x cutoff, kept when their own response is below the cutoff

prototypes.label: gen020
prototypes.design: Local waffle against local waffle plus local mean, then response eigenvectors of the waffle part, cutoff 0.20

prototypes.label: tws030
prototypes.design: Split by local waffle, then response eigenvectors of the twin subspace, band below 1.5 x cutoff, cutoff 0.30
